caveat: single-render acoustic probe; synthesis variance not yet calibrated (panel: n>=3 medians before frozen thresholds); perceived affect requires the blinded human read
sentence: I looked at what you sent, and I think we should take it one step at a time, together.

facts: chatterbox accepts a closed 15-tone vocabulary; any other tone label silently normalizes to neutral_warm -> neutral stage -> default sampling params (temperature 0.80).
dream arm tone firm_boundary IS in ALLOWED_TONES -> deflecting stage -> temperature 0.70, top_p 0.90, repetition_penalty 1.24: a real synthesis-parameter change.
wrong-dream arm tone neutral_reflective is NOT in ALLOWED_TONES -> normalized to neutral_warm -> SAME sampling params as the flat arm. The wrong arm is therefore an accidental second flat control.

reading.note: flat (44.47) vs wrong (37.72) rendered with identical sampling params; their 6.75 Hz F0-SD gap estimates single-render synthesis variance.
reading.note2: dream arm F0-SD shift (44.47->32.03) is ~1.8x the same-param variance estimate: directionally real (lower temperature narrows prosodic variance, consistent with firm/steady), but single renders cannot separate it with confidence. n>=3 medians required, per panel.
reading.tuning_consequence: most TAG_FAMILY_TONE/TAG_FLOOR_TONE output labels are outside ALLOWED_TONES and are acoustically inert at the sampling layer; dream-weight tuning must first remap composer output onto the allowed tone vocabulary or the coloring never reaches synthesis.
